title: Punjab Medical Teaching Institutions Reforms Amendment Ordinance 2021

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Medical Teaching Institutions Reforms Amendment Ordinance 2021
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 743
PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 743
ORDINANCE XXI OF 2021
PUNJAB MEDICAL TEACHING INSTITUTIONS
(REFORMS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2021
An Ordinance to amend Punjab Medical Teaching
Institutions (Reforms) Act, 2020
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
22nd April, 2021]
No.Legis:13-21/2018,
dated 22.4.2021.---The following
Ordinance promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
Information:
It
is necessary to amend the Punjab Medical Teaching Institutions (Reforms) Act
2020 to incorporate certain provisions for smooth implementation of the Act and
other relevant laws.
Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and Governor of the Punjab is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate
action.
In
exercise of the powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be cited as the Punjab Medical Teaching Institutions (Reforms)
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2021.
(2) This
Ordinance shall come into force at once.

PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 743
PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 743

(REFORMS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2021
An Ordinance to amend Punjab Medical Teaching
Institutions (Reforms) Act, 2020
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
22nd April, 2021]
No.Legis:13-21/2018,
dated 22.4.2021.---The following
Ordinance promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
Information:
It
is necessary to amend the Punjab Medical Teaching Institutions (Reforms) Act
2020 to incorporate certain provisions for smooth implementation of the Act and
other relevant laws.
Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and Governor of the Punjab is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate
action.
In
exercise of the powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:
3. Amendment
of section 6 of Act II of 2020.---In
the Act, in section 6, in subsection (1):
(a) for
clause (c), the following shall be substituted;
"(c)
determine, in consultation with the Government, the base standards for the
Medical Teaching Institutions, and enhance such standards from time to time, as
and when required,";
(b) clause
(d) shall be omitted;
(c) for
clause (i), the following shall be substituted:
"(i)
establish the minimum qualification standards for all posts in a Medical
Teaching Institution for merit-based appointments, subject to the standards
established by the Pakistan Medical Commission or any other regulatory
authority, and subject to the discretion of the Board of a Medical Teaching
Institution to enhance such minimum qualification standards;";
(d) after
subsection (3), the following subsection (4) shall be added:
"(4)
The Policy Board shall conduct its business in such manner as may be
prescribed.".
